scientific_choices.rationale: Optimize only masked BCE+Dice(K), preserving the qualified augmented/native owner-to-kernel construction. No Text, Separator or Gap loss.

Fine-tune the qualified extracted Kernel checkpoint for50 additional epochs with fresh Adam1e-5; frozen ResNet50/BN, trainable decoder/head. This is not training from scratch or a matched simultaneous M+K continuation.
Maximize validation per-image macro Kernel IoU at fixed0.5, then F1 and earliest epoch; epoch0 included. OCR and padding do not select training checkpoints.

After all50 epochs, evaluate the best checkpoint using unchanged0/2/4/6/8/12 native padding and qualified PARSeq. Report padded and unpadded localization plus exact OCR on all983 TRAIN-holdout care words.
RTX3090 rather than3070 target; single FP32 batch8 model, TF32off, sequential PARSeq with measured peaks, no CPU fallback.
Independent validation, seed replication, from-scratch Kernel-only training and causal isolation from further optimization are absent. This experiment is approximate reproduction/research extension.
